source: 刘晓燕《四级你还在背单词吗》
title: The Shop on the Frontier
tts_text: Marlow is a small town on the frontier, right on the rim of the sea. A low hedge runs along the boundary of the square, and the fields stretch to the horizon. From the edge of the square you can see the whole harbour. Old Mr. Bai had kept a shop there for forty years. Every morning he carried his telescope up to the roof and watched the ships come in. "I can only speculate," he said, "but that one is bound for the north." From his perspective, nothing in the square was hidden. The red roof of his shop was the most conspicuous thing in town. He imported cloth and exported tea. Half his goods he sold wholesale, half at retail, and he was the only seller of English thread in the county. He advertised nothing at all. "My prices speak for me," he said. "This town has prospered for a hundred years." A young porter carried the bags from the ferry, and a tailor knew every detail of every coat. Travelers showed their passports at the gate and then walked into the square. That spring the market began to slump. The bumper of a delivery truck bumped the hedge, and a lump of wet clay fell into the road. Apples bounced out of a box and rolled across the square. In the afternoon the old man found a small bomb beside the well. "It is only a joke," someone said. He did not laugh. He asked two men to brace the shop wall, and then he stood at the margin of the square.

sentences_cn: 马洛是一座边境上的小镇，就坐落在海边。
一道矮树篱沿着广场的边界延伸，篱笆那边，田野一直铺到地平线。
从广场边上望出去，整个港口尽收眼底。
老白先生在那儿开了四十年的铺子。
每天早上他都把望远镜搬上屋顶，看着进港的船。
“我只能推测，”他说，“不过那艘船是往北去的。”
从他的角度看，广场上没有什么藏得住的东西。
他那红屋顶是全镇最引人注目的东西。
他进口布匹，出口茶叶。
他的货一半批发，一半零售，而且他是全县唯一卖英国线的人。
他从不做广告。
“我的价钱会替我说话，”他说。
“这座镇子已经繁荣了一百年。”
一个年轻的搬运工把行李从渡轮上扛下来，裁缝清楚每一件外套的每一个细节。
旅客在门口出示护照，然后走进广场。
那年春天，市场开始萧条。
一辆送货车的保险杠撞上了树篱，一块湿泥巴掉到了路上。
苹果从箱子里弹出来，滚过广场。
下午，老人在井边发现了一枚小炸弹。
“只是个玩笑，”有人说。
他没有笑。
他叫两个人用木头撑住铺子的墙，然后站在广场边缘。

words.mnemonic: spec 表示“看”；ul 发音类似 “you(你)”;ate 动词后缀。因此，speculate 可以 理解为“你看的动作”，从而引发“思考或推测”。
words.zhenti: The researchers speculate that craft activities promote the development of nerve pathways in the brain. 研究人员推测，手工艺 活动促进了大脑神经通路的发展。
words.sentence: "I can only speculate," he said
words.root: spec(看) + ulate → 看来看去 → 推测
words.family: speculation n. 推测 / spectator n. 观众
words.derived: speculation /ıspekju'leıʃn/ n.推测；投 机买卖

words.mnemonic: per表示“每一个”；spect 表示 “看”;ive名词后缀，每一个都看到了。只有当 你把事物的每一面都看到时，你才能得出对这 个事物的“看法，观点”。
words.zhenti: It's nice to have people agree, but you need conflicting perspectives to dig out the truth.人们意见一致是件好事，但你需要相互 矛盾的观点来挖掘真相。(2015)
words.sentence: From his perspective, nothing in the square was hidden
words.root: per(每一个) + spect(看) + ive → 每一面都看到 → 观点
words.family: spectacle n. 景象 / spectator n. 观众

words.mnemonic: pro表示“向前”；sper 表示“希 望”，向前的希望→繁荣，昌盛。
words.sentence: This town has prospered for a hundred years
words.root: pro(向前) + sper(希望) → 前面有希望 → 繁荣
words.family: prosperity n. 繁荣 / prosperous adj. 繁荣的
words.derived: prosperous /'prpspərəs/ adj.繁荣的 prosperity /prp'sperəti/ n.繁荣，昌盛

words.mnemonic: con 表示“所有人”；spic 表示 “看”；uous是形容词后缀。所有人都看得到的 →显著的，引人注目的。

words.mnemonic: tele 表示“远的”，比如 television， 电视就是把远的图像(vision)传到你的眼前； telephone，电话就是把远处的声音(phone)传到 你耳边；telescope，望远镜就是把远的视野 (scope)传到你的眼前。
words.zhenti: Buy $ 50 million worth of new telescopes right now.现在就购买价值 5 000万美元的新 望远镜。
words.sentence: Every morning he carried his telescope up to the roof
words.root: tele(远) + scope(看) → 看远处的东西
words.family: microscope n. 显微镜 / scope n. 范围

words.cn: 边缘，页边空白；白边；利润，盈余
words.mnemonic: Mar（火星），gin（想成汉字 “进”)。设想一下：我们去了火星。进火星是不 是得从火星的边缘进去？所以该单词意为“边 缘”。
words.zhenti: Most students write questions or short notes in the margins. 大多数学生在页边空白处 写问题或简短的笔记。(2014)

words.root: marg(边) + in → 边上的地方 → 边缘
words.family: marginal adj. 边缘的；微小的

words.family: horizontal adj. 水平的

words.mnemonic: James Bound 詹姆斯·邦德是 电影《007》的主角，Bound可是界限感很强的 (150) 人，惩恶扬善，完成危险任务，因此看到bound 十ary可以记忆为“分界线”。

words.cn: 一定会；很可能会，有义务(做某事)；准备 前往(某地)v.跳跃着跑；形成……的边界(或 界限）
